text.en:
The Gapan Provincial High School situated in the Municipality of Gapan, Province of Nueva
Ecija, is hereby converted into national high school to be known as the Gapan National High School.

The Ministry of Education and Culture is hereby directed to take steps as are necessary for the
conversion, operation and immediate implementation of this Act.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be
provided for in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
